follow-on: the assertion compares each record's plan_fingerprint with the fingerprint the test itself passed into _store_fingerprint_only_review, so the equality is a store round-trip and the assertion's real guard is that records is non-empty, not which form matched.

follow-on: the comment still enumerates collapse_section as one of the three landing-beat write ops the skill names, now stale since the op is retired; the file was not updated and this change is what made the comment wrong.

item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is to retire the pre-collapse fingerprint form and the collapse_section op so _fingerprint_forms returns the section-set and whole-document forms only; reckon/crew/plan_review.py:678 returns exactly those two forms (a 2-tuple) and the op is gone from reckon/_store.py _OP_DISPATCH and reckon/mcp.py _OP_VOCAB.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at manifest.md; status complete, after_suite cites head-arm.log 506 passed EXIT=0 (the artefact now carries it), baseline_suite cites base-arm.log 501 passed EXIT=0, and the negative control is recorded, so the prior review's blocking finding is resolved.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff against f819399 touches 12 paths; reckon/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/_store.py, reckon/mcp.py, skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md and tests/test_the_fingerprint_has_one_form.py are in the node's declared scope, and the six extra test files were each authorised by the resume advisories (resume-3 treat the two ancesed by resume-1 and four by resume-3), so the diff is inside the extended scope even though the plan node's write_paths were never widened.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_fingerprint_has_one_form.py:144 asserts the retired pre-collapse digest is not among the forms and :185 asserts a review stored under it no longer matches, and the declared negative control reddens both.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's head-arm.log carries 506 passed EXIT=0 at d979530c and base-arm.log 501 passed EXIT=0 at f819399, so the added-failure count derived from them is 0, and negative-control-mutation.log records the restored form reddening two cases EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: the new cases restate each form from its own definitions (tests/test_the_fingerprint_has_one_form.py:28,:140) and the plan_review.py:684 docstring states the mechanism rather than the retired behaviour.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:678 returns the section-set and whole-document pair and reckon/_store.py:3279 no longer dispatches collapse_section, so the retirement the goal names has landed.
justifications.reuse: the change shrinks reckon/crew/plan_review.py:678 to the two surviving forms and deletes the unreachable collapse helpers, and the test restates forms from the owner primitives _digest and _section_digests rather than forking them.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path was authorised, but six test files sit outside the dispatch's declared seven paths (widened only by resume advice) and manifest.md:17 names just three of the six, so an auditor reading that line sees an understated scope.
